# Ahsan Mahmood portfolio guide

> Public guide to five ways of building software and how Ahsan Mahmood compares with each.

- [Guide](https://docs.aoneahsan.com/)

The main portfolio and current product pages are at https://aoneahsan.com/. The comparison pages show the date their examples were last checked.
